scope_rationale: The canonical node is explicitly a lifetime GHG total. The same normalized description and source-extracted capacity identify the full 70-community, 4.83 MW project. Both the executive summary and impact indicators distinguish its 1,027,227 lifetime total from Tranche 1's 821,782. This correction aligns the canonical impact scalar with that existing full-project boundary; it does not resolve the separately undetermined financing scope.
unchanged: Pinned upstream raw ClimateFund JSON and its source hash
Source description, source-extracted annual 41,049 tCO2e figure, and 25-year lifespan
Synthetic generator rules, versions, seeds and unrelated assumptions
Historical experiment records, scores, reports and snapshot artifacts
derived_value_policy: Regenerate deterministic artifacts using the corrected scalar. Dividing 1,027,227 by 25 yields 41,089.08 tCO2e/year as a benchmark calculation, not a replacement for either source annual figure.
generation_policy: No model calls are part of the correction. Old-input responses must not be silently rescored against corrected facts; identify changed input and output dependencies before any separately authorized new generation.
